content.json:
# Knowledge API
Volume, latency, refusals and dependency failures of `POST /api/ask`. Counts and span attributes only: no question or document text.

content.query:
requests
| where name == "POST api/ask"
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), status = strcat(substring(resultCode, 0, 1), "xx")
| render timechart
content.title: Questions per hour by status class

content.query:
requests
| where name == "POST api/ask" and resultCode == "200"
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: End-to-end latency (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where name in ("llm.generate", "graph.search")
| summarize p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by name, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: p95 of the model call and the Graph search (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where name == "ask"
| extend refused = tostring(customDimensions["kb.refused"]) == "true", reason = tostring(customDimensions["kb.refusal.reason"])
| summarize answers = count(), refusals = countif(refused), refusal_rate_pct = round(100.0 * countif(refused) / count(), 1) by reason = iff(isempty(reason), "(answered)", reason)
| order by answers desc
content.title: Answers and refusals

content.query:
traces
| where message has "ask.upstream-failed"
| extend d = parse_json(message)
| summarize failures = count() by errKind = tostring(d["kind"]), httpStatus = tostring(d.status), errCode = tostring(d.code)
| order by failures desc
content.title: Dependency failures (Azure OpenAI throttling shows as llm-unavailable / 429)
